# Chapter Quiz Feature
## Overview
After completing all lessons in a chapter, users are now presented with a comprehensive quiz to test their knowledge before marking the chapter as complete. This ensures better learning outcomes and knowledge retention.
## Flow
### Old Flow ``` Last Lesson → Chapter Complete Page ```
### New Flow ``` Last Lesson → Chapter Quiz → Chapter Complete Page ```
## Implementation
### 1. Quiz Data Structure (`/lib/chapter-quizzes.ts`)
Each chapter can have a quiz with: - **Chapter ID**: Identifies the chapter - **Chapter Title**: Display name - **Passing Score**: Percentage required to pass (typically 70%) - **Questions**: Array of quiz questions
**Question Structure:** ```typescript { id: string // Unique identifier question: string // Question text options: string[] // Array of answer options correctAnswer: number // Index of correct answer (0-based) explanation: string // Explanation shown after answering } ```
### 2. Quiz Page (`/app/course/[chapterId]/quiz/page.tsx`)
- Server component that loads quiz data - Passes data to client component - Shows header with chapter info - Displays passing score requirement
### 3. Quiz Client Component (`/components/chapter-quiz-client.tsx`)
**Features:** - ✅ One question at a time - ✅ Progress indicator - ✅ Answer selection with radio buttons - ✅ Previous/Next navigation - ✅ Score calculation - ✅ Pass/Fail indication - ✅ Answer review with explanations - ✅ Retake option - ✅ Continue to complete page (after passing)
**States:** 1. **Quiz Mode**: Showing questions one by one 2. **Results Mode**: Showing score and answer review
### 4. Updated Navigation (`/components/lesson-navigation.tsx`)
When on the last lesson of a chapter, the "Next" button now navigates to: ``` /course/[chapterId]/quiz ```
Instead of: ``` /course/[chapterId]/complete ```
## Quiz Data
### Current Quizzes
**Foundation** (5 questions) - Webiny architecture and infrastructure - Core applications - Multi-tenancy - React framework
**Getting Started** (3 questions) - Project setup - Project structure - Using images
**Headless CMS** (3 questions) - Content models - GraphQL API - Field types
**Serverless** (3 questions) - Serverless advantages - AWS Lambda - Infrastructure as code
**Website Builder** (3 questions) - Page Builder usage - Custom elements - Page rendering
**Best Practices** (3 questions) - Security practices - Performance optimization - Testing and deployment
### Adding New Quizzes
To add a quiz for a new chapter, add it to `/lib/chapter-quizzes.ts`:
```typescript export const chapterQuizzes: Record<string, ChapterQuiz> = { // ...existing quizzes "new-chapter": { chapterId: "new-chapter", chapterTitle: "New Chapter Title", passingScore: 70, questions: [ { id: "new-chapter-1", question: "What is X?", options: ["A", "B", "C", "D"], correctAnswer: 1, // B is correct explanation: "B is correct because..." }, // More questions... ] } } ```
## User Experience
### Taking the Quiz
1. User completes last lesson in chapter 2. Clicks "Next" button 3. Redirected to `/course/[chapterId]/quiz` 4. Sees introduction with passing score requirement 5. Answers questions one at a time 6. Can navigate back to previous questions 7. Submits quiz after last question
### Quiz Results
**If Passed (≥70%):** - Green success message - Score display - Review of all answers with explanations - "Continue to Chapter Complete" button - "Retake Quiz" option
**If Failed (<70%):** - Orange message encouraging review - Score display - Review of all answers with explanations - "Retake Quiz" button (only option) - Must pass to continue to complete page
### Retaking the Quiz
- Click "Retake Quiz" button - Quiz resets to first question - All previous answers cleared - Can take quiz unlimited times
## UI Components
### Progress Bar - Shows current question number - Visual progress indicator - Percentage completion
### Question Card - Large, clear question text - Radio button style options - Hover effects - Selected state highlighting
### Answer Review - Color-coded correct/incorrect - User's answer shown - Correct answer shown (if wrong) - Explanation for each question - Visual checkmark/X icons
### Results Card - Large score display - Pass/Fail badge - Breakdown (X/Y correct) - Encouraging message
## Styling
### Colors
**Pass State:** - Green: `text-green-600`, `bg-green-500/10`, `border-green-500/50`
**Fail State:** - Orange: `text-orange-600`, `bg-orange-500/10`, `border-orange-500/50`
**Question States:** - Selected: `border-primary`, `bg-primary/10` - Hover: `hover:border-primary/50` - Default: `border-border`
### Layout - Max width: 2xl (672px) - Centered on page - Responsive design - Mobile-friendly
## Testing
### Test Quiz Flow
1. Navigate to any chapter's last lesson: ``` http://localhost:3000/course/foundation/webiny-apps ```
2. Click "Next" button
3. Should redirect to quiz: ``` http://localhost:3000/course/foundation/quiz ```
4. Complete quiz and verify: - Can answer questions - Progress updates - Can navigate back - Results display correctly - Can retake - Can continue after passing
### Test Direct Access
Visit quiz page directly: ``` http://localhost:3000/course/foundation/quiz ```
Should work and show quiz interface.
## Future Enhancements
Possible improvements:
- [ ] Save quiz progress (in case of page refresh) - [ ] Timer for quiz completion - [ ] Randomize question order - [ ] Randomize answer order - [ ] Show statistics (average score, completion rate) - [ ] Certificate generation for passing - [ ] Leaderboard - [ ] Different difficulty levels - [ ] Question hints - [ ] Skip to specific question - [ ] Quiz analytics (which questions are hardest)
## Benefits
**For Users:** - ✅ Tests knowledge retention - ✅ Identifies knowledge gaps - ✅ Reinforces learning - ✅ Immediate feedback - ✅ Explanations aid understanding
**For Course:** - ✅ Ensures comprehension - ✅ Quality control - ✅ Better learning outcomes - ✅ Engagement mechanism - ✅ Progress validation
## Files Created/Modified
**Created:** 1. `/lib/chapter-quizzes.ts` - Quiz data and questions 2. `/components/chapter-quiz-client.tsx` - Interactive quiz component 3. `/app/course/[chapterId]/quiz/page.tsx` - Quiz page route
**Modified:** 1. `/components/lesson-navigation.tsx` - Updated to go to quiz instead of complete
## Summary
The chapter quiz feature: - ✅ Appears after completing all chapter lessons - ✅ Tests knowledge with multiple-choice questions - ✅ Requires 70% to pass - ✅ Provides immediate feedback - ✅ Shows explanations for all answers - ✅ Allows unlimited retakes - ✅ Must pass to continue to chapter complete page - ✅ Enhances learning experience
Users now have a comprehensive assessment before marking a chapter as complete!
